title: Rehearse a candidate with its own dependencies when its lock differs
goal: A dependency change does not block or mislead updates
acceptance: A committed test fails first: a candidate lock differing from the installed one gets its own dependencies in staging, or a refusal naming the change; equal locks keep the link
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18: lock comparison, a bounded npm ci in staging and a test. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-19: PR #538 merged with its committed regression; CI run 44429968461 passed every job.
